record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare LAST_RESPECTS as skill: Houndstone (2 stars) and Greavard (1 star); both also declare the passive of the same name. The passive is a separate mechanism (an on-death effect in PokemonEntity, see evidence passive-death) and is not covered by this record except where it can start a cast; the identifier is shared between ability and passive (routing uncertainty NAME_SHARED_WITH_PASSIVE). Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single target, immediate. The strategy first computes a curse delay, then lists the enemies (entities of the cast target's team) that stand in the 8 cells around the caster and are not currently cursed, and picks one of them at random as the curse target. SPECIAL damage (raw 30 at 1 star, 60 at 2 stars; 90 / 180 for 3 / 4 stars exist in the table) is dealt to the curse target, or, if there is none, to the original cast target. After the damage, the curse target (only when one was found) receives a curse with the computed delay (10000 ms at 1 star, 8000 ms at 2 stars before AP and crit; 6000 / 4000 for 3 / 4 stars). When the curse timer runs out the cursed unit takes 9999 TRUE damage. The fallback target (no eligible adjacent enemy) takes the damage and gets no curse. The damage is not conditioned on the curse being accepted; the curse is requested after the damage (a curse target that died from the damage is still passed to triggerCurse; what that does was not traced).

targeting.who: a random uncursed enemy in the 8 cells around the caster (damage and curse); the cast target as fallback (damage only)
targeting.note: The cast target defines the team to look for and the fallback; with range 1 it is normally adjacent, but if it is already cursed it is not eligible and another adjacent uncursed enemy is chosen instead. The pick is uniform random (pickRandomIn).

geometry.shape: the 8 cells around the caster (centre excluded), on-board only; no displacement

effects.target: the curse target (random uncursed adjacent enemy), else the cast target
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT; x critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT), reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite. The AP and the crit also shorten the curse delay (see the CURSE status). Not conditioned on the curse.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The returned takenDamage / death is not used by this ability.

statusEffects.target: the curse target only (not the fallback target)
statusEffects.durationMs: 10000 (1 star) / 8000 (2 stars) before AP and crit

declaredRaw.label: requested curse delay (ms) before AP and crit

statusEffects.scaling: requested delay = min(0)(table[stars-1] x (1 - 0.2 x AP / 100) x (crit ? 1 - (critPower - 1) x 0.2 : 1)); AP shortens it (at AP 500 or more the factor reaches 0, and the delay is clamped at 0 for the product), a crit shortens it by (critPower - 1) x 20 % (x0.8 at critPower 2). The cast-time AP and crit are read once.
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied unless the target has rune protect. If the unit's curse was cleared earlier and a cooldown remains, the applied delay is the smaller of the remaining cooldown and the new one; otherwise the delay gets +1000 ms per Odd Keystone in the victim's player's items. A curse is a flag with a timer; when the timer is <= 0 the flag is cleared and the unit takes 9999 TRUE damage via handleDamage (attacker null): protect / skydiving still make handleDamage deal no damage (so the unit may survive), a shield absorbs part of it first, and the kill is attributed to no attacker. Clearing negative statuses removes the flag but leaves the cooldown (extended by 2000 ms), so the later trigger reuses the remaining time. A unit that is already cursed is never chosen (it is filtered out), so the 'already cursed -> immediate' branch of triggerCurse is not reached from this ability.

starBehavior.note: Stars index the damage (30, 60, 90, 180; ?? 180) and the curse delay (10000, 8000, 6000, 4000; ?? 4000). The listed units are catalog stars 1 and 2. The source comment lists 1-3 star damage only and says delays for 1-4 stars; the code has four entries each. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

passiveRelation.note: The passive of the same name is a different mechanism (on-death PP refill of adjacent same-team units with that passive); it is not part of this ability's process and is only cited to keep the two apart.

record.positionalConditions: The curse target must stand in one of the 8 cells around the caster and be of the cast target's team and uncursed; otherwise the cast target takes the damage without a curse. The caster's own cell is not considered.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP (140) of PP and picks a new random curse target among adjacent uncursed enemies, so successive casts tend to spread curses over different adjacent enemies; when every adjacent enemy is already cursed the damage goes to the cast target with no new curse. The separate passive (adjacent allies' deaths refill PP of LAST_RESPECTS-passive units) can make casts more frequent but is not part of this process.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30 / 60 (1 / 2 stars) and a curse of 10000 / 8000 ms before AP and crit. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied curse delay = requested after the AP and crit shortening, then (refusal under rune protect, remaining-cooldown minimum, +1000 ms per Odd Keystone); the curse's own damage is 9999 TRUE, subject to protect / skydiving and shields.
